gloss: to be heard, to be audible

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {聞|き}こえていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to be heard, to be audible
definitions.explanation: For a sound to reach one's ears and be perceivable. The intransitive/potential form of hearing.
To give the impression of a certain quality when heard.

examples.japanese: ⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{言|い}い{訳|わけ}→言い訳：04653_iiwake⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{聞|き}こえる。
⟦{隣|となり}→隣：01003_tonari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{音楽|おんがく}→音楽：00661_ongaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{聞|き}こえて⟦きた→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: Music could be heard coming from the next room.
examples.notes: {聞|き}こえてくる = come to be heard

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{冗談|じょうだん}→冗談：03347_joudan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{聞|き}こえた⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{本気|ほんき}→本気：03153_honki⟧だった。
examples.english: His story sounded like a joke, but he was serious.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{小|ちい}さくて→小さい：00025_chiisai⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧{聞|き}こえなかった。
examples.english: The voice on the phone was quiet and I couldn't hear it well.

examples.japanese: ⟦{遠|とお}く→遠い：00529_tooi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{太鼓|たいこ}→太鼓：04049_taiko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{音|おと}→音：00743_oto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{聞|き}こえて⟦きて→来る：00254_kuru⟧、⟦お{祭|まつ}り→祭り：03735_matsuri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まった→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{分|わ}かった→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: I heard the sound of drums from far away and knew the festival had started.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{冷|つめ}たく→冷たい：00681_tsumetai⟧{聞|き}こえた⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{本当|ほんとう}→本当：00779_hontou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{心配|しんぱい}して→心配：00811_shinpai⟧⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: Her words sounded cold, but she was actually worried.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: ⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧ (intransitive). This is the spontaneous/potential form related to ⟦{聞|き}く→聞く：00483_kiku⟧ (to hear/listen). Pattern: X⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{聞|き}こえる (X can be heard).

ASPECT: て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ indicates ongoing state. {聞|き}こえて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ = 'can be heard' (continuous).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{聞|き}こえる (a voice can be heard)
- ⟦{音|おと}→音：00743_oto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{聞|き}こえる (a sound can be heard)
- ⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧{聞|き}こえない (can't hear well)
- {聞|き}こえて⟦くる→来る：00254_kuru⟧ (come to be heard, start hearing)
- 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{聞|き}こえる (sound like ~)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{聞|き}く→聞く：00483_kiku⟧: active listening/asking (transitive)
- {聞|き}こえる: passive hearing, audibility (intransitive)

RELATED PAIR: ⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧ → ⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧ (see → be visible) follows the same pattern.
